item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 25/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A humid southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. There will be a few showers over the region. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, it will be generally fine and hot over the coastal areas of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong early next week, it will be windy with more showers, and the temperatures will be slightly lower over the region. Meanwhile, an area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea.
